create_trajectory_frame_from_atoms: create a TrajectoryFrame from an ASE Atoms object using the from_atoms class method
convert_trajectory_frame_to_dict: convert a TrajectoryFrame dataclass instance to a dictionary for Parquet serialization using to_dict
write_trajectory_to_parquet: write molecular dynamics trajectory frames to a Parquet file using ParquetTrajectoryWriter with buffered appends
use_parquet_writer_context_manager: use ParquetTrajectoryWriter as a context manager to automatically flush and close trajectory data on exit
flush_trajectory_buffer: flush buffered TrajectoryFrame data to disk by calling the flush method on ParquetTrajectoryWriter
